<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="bg" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#FFBBCD"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#FFFFFF"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="banner" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#F38093"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#FFBBCD"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-30%" y="-30%" width="160%" height="170%">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="4"/>
    </filter>
    <filter id="soft" x="-30%" y="-30%" width="160%" height="170%">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="2"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="url(#bg)"/>

  <!-- status bar -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="44" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <text x="20" y="27" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="14px" font-weight="900" fill="#000000">9:41</text>
  <line x1="326" y1="27" x2="331" y2="27" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="334" y1="24" x2="334" y2="27" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="339" y1="21" x2="339" y2="27" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="344" y1="18" x2="344" y2="27" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <path d="M352 25 Q358 18 364 25 M355 25 Q358 21 361 25" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.8"/>
  <rect x="370" y="17" width="18" height="11" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="372" y="19" width="12" height="7" rx="2" fill="#000000"/>
  <rect x="388" y="20" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>

  <!-- image banner -->
  <rect x="18" y="58" width="354" height="201" rx="31" fill="#000000" opacity=".18" filter="url(#shadow)"/>
  <rect x="18" y="54" width="354" height="201" rx="31" fill="url(#banner)"/>
  <circle cx="319" cy="92" r="25" fill="#FFD663" opacity=".95"/>
  <polygon points="35,226 117,151 166,205 214,158 312,255 35,255" fill="#F99DAA"/>
  <polygon points="155,255 232,178 282,215 327,177 372,224 372,255" fill="#F38093" opacity=".65"/>
  <path d="M70 114 Q103 82 137 113 Q104 102 70 114Z" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".75"/>
  <path d="M247 132 Q276 105 307 133 Q278 120 247 132Z" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".55"/>
  <path d="M173 157 Q187 128 211 139 Q228 147 247 128 Q232 163 205 166 Q185 169 173 157Z" fill="#000000" opacity=".78"/>
  <path d="M202 144 Q213 119 239 111 Q220 137 208 158Z" fill="#50555C"/>
  <path d="M174 157 Q146 144 134 164 Q151 168 174 157Z" fill="#F88D9C"/>
  <path d="M207 165 Q219 180 235 188" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="222" cy="137" r="3" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- title -->
  <text x="195" y="294" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="28px" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Welcome back</text>
  <text x="195" y="320" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="16px" font-weight="400" fill="#50555C">Sign in to continue chirping</text>

  <!-- email field -->
  <text x="39" y="352" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="16px" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Email</text>
  <rect x="39" y="360" width="312" height="52" rx="26" fill="#000000" opacity=".15" filter="url(#soft)"/>
  <rect x="39" y="356" width="312" height="52" rx="26" fill="#F99DAA" opacity=".72"/>
  <circle cx="62" cy="382" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8"/>
  <line x1="45" y1="382" x2="79" y2="382" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8"/>
  <text x="88" y="388" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="16px" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">you@example.com</text>

  <!-- password field -->
  <text x="39" y="443" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="16px" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Password</text>
  <rect x="39" y="451" width="312" height="52" rx="26" fill="#000000" opacity=".15" filter="url(#soft)"/>
  <rect x="39" y="447" width="312" height="52" rx="26" fill="#F99DAA" opacity=".72"/>
  <rect x="52" y="466" width="17" height="14" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8"/>
  <path d="M56 466 Q56 456 60.5 456 Q65 456 65 466" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8"/>
  <circle cx="60.5" cy="473" r="2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <text x="88" y="479" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="18px" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="4" fill="#FFFFFF">••••••••</text>
  <text x="39" y="526" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="14px" font-weight="400" fill="#F38093">Forgot password?</text>

  <!-- sign in button -->
  <g>
    <rect x="101" y="553" width="188" height="54" rx="31" fill="#000000" opacity=".18" filter="url(#soft)"/>
    <rect x="101" y="549" width="188" height="54" rx="31" fill="#F88D9C"/>
    <text x="195" y="583" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="20px" font-weight="900" fill="#FFFFFF">Sign In</text>
  </g>

  <!-- helper divider -->
  <line x1="39" y1="636" x2="153" y2="636" stroke="#F38093" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="237" y1="636" x2="351" y2="636" stroke="#F38093" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="195" y="641" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="14px" font-weight="400" fill="#50555C">or</text>

  <g>
    <rect x="108" y="662" width="174" height="43" rx="28" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".78"/>
    <circle cx="135" cy="684" r="9" fill="#F38093"/>
    <polyline points="130,684 134,688 141,679" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="202" y="690" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="16px" font-weight="700" fill="#F38093">Create account</text>
  </g>

  <!-- back link -->
  <polyline points="40,735 32,743 40,751" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="52" y="749" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="17px" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">Back</text>

  <!-- bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="776" width="390" height="68" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".93"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="776" x2="390" y2="776" stroke="#F99DAA" stroke-width="1"/>
  <g>
    <polygon points="39,802 49,794 59,802 59,814 39,814" fill="none" stroke="#F38093" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polyline points="35,802 49,791 63,802" fill="none" stroke="#F38093" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="49" y="834" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="11px" font-weight="400" fill="#F38093">Home</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="126" cy="801" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#50555C" stroke-width="2"/>
    <ellipse cx="126" cy="812" rx="11" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#50555C" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="126" y="834" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="11px" font-weight="400" fill="#50555C">Friends</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="195" cy="801" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#50555C" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="195" y1="789" x2="195" y2="813" stroke="#50555C" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="183" y1="801" x2="207" y2="801" stroke="#50555C" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="195" y="834" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="11px" font-weight="400" fill="#50555C">Birds</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="258" y="793" width="24" height="17" rx="6" fill="none" stroke="#50555C" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polygon points="263,810 261,816 268,811" fill="#50555C"/>
    <text x="270" y="834" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="11px" font-weight="400" fill="#50555C">Chirp</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="340" cy="801" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#50555C" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="340" y1="801" x2="340" y2="795" stroke="#50555C" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="340" y1="801" x2="345" y2="804" stroke="#50555C" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="340" y="834" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="11px" font-weight="400" fill="#50555C">Map</text>
  </g>
</svg>
